title: Open a ticket flow, Tools menu and staff-created client accounts
summary: Public Open a ticket is login-first with one combined form that routes into the chosen service. Guests and public users get Bookings under Tools and a Public Register label. Staff, volunteers and students can create local public client accounts with a phone PIN shown once and an optional 72-hour set-password email.
changes: Guests must sign in or use Public Register before opening a ticket; signed-in public users pick a service and area on one form that submits straight into that service's ticket system, with no triage queue.
Old /open-a-ticket/{service}/{area}/start URLs redirect into the combined form with the service and area pre-selected.
Public users see a Tools menu above Support with Bookings under Tools; staff-side roles lose Bookings from the menu and receive 403 on those routes.
Guest chrome renames Register to Public Register.

Staff, volunteers and students with staff.clients.create can create local public client accounts: duplicate email/phone and staff-domain emails are refused; a 4–8 digit PIN is required, shown once, stored hashed, and never emailed or logged; optional email can send a 72-hour set-password link without the PIN; staff-assisted consent and audit record creation without secrets.
version_rationale: Minor: new public ticket flow behaviour, navigation changes, and staff client-account creation with a new permission.
validation: PHPUnit feature coverage for PublicOpenTicketPageTest, BookingsPagesTest, StaffClientAccountTest, registration gate and staff help pages.
composer pre-pr-verify and CI checks on the milestone pull request.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release tag and restore the previous database backup if client-consent columns or set-password tokens need to be removed.
provenance: Milestone epic #661 and pull request #844 on the milestone/v0-65-0-open-ticket-flow-tools branch.
